title: How to Contact Netflix Customer Service! [2020]
description: In this video, I talk about how you can contact Netflix customer service. Netflix has this customer service call feature built right into the Netflix app and it becomes very handy to contact Netflix support right from your phone. You don't need to google for any customer care number, simply go to Help section of Netflix app and you should find this Call button to contact Netflix Customer service. I've already tried this method and it work amazingly well. asr.full_text: Hello friends so this little tip is for all those people who are active members of Netflix so in case if you face an issue with Netflix app you can go ahead and call their call center number you can find their call center number on Google but what if I tell you you don't have to do that see Netflix has this amazing feature built inside the app which allows you to call customary care right from the app so if you ever face any issue with Netflix app just launch the app and go to this more option see the more option and then you want to hit this help option this and there is this call button you want to press on this button and then it will connect to Netflix customer support it's an amazing feature built inside Netflix app I hope you didn't know it and I've already tested this. I was feeling a bit low with my network password but I called the customer care asap and they solved my issue immediately and this is a very handy way of contacting Netflix which is why I thought of sharing it with you all. I hope you find this tip helpful. and that's all for today. Thank you for Watching and I ll see you guys in the next one.
